import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

# Achiral SMILES
achiral = "[N-]=[N+]=C1C2=C(C(O)C(O)C(O)(C)C2O)C3=C1C(=O)c1c(O)cccc1C3=O"
m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(achiral)

# pixel coords from drawing (original image coordinates), atom idx -> (px,py)
pix = {
 0:(575,600),   # N beta
 1:(567,542),   # N alpha
 2:(555,467),   # V7 diazo C
 3:(657,368),   # V6
 4:(552,275),   # V1
 5:(597,165),   # V2 (CH-OH down)
 6:(560,105),   # O of V2-OH
 7:(712,158),   # V3 (CH-OH up)
 8:(755,95),    # O of V3-OH
 9:(778,245),   # V4 quaternary
 10:(850,205),  # methyl C (up)
 11:(835,285),  # O of V4-OH (down)
 12:(742,358),  # V5 (CH-OH down)
 13:(800,415),  # O of V5-OH
 14:(437,308),  # B2
 15:(437,432),  # B3
 16:(330,490),  # B4 carbonyl C
 17:(330,610),  # O carbonyl bottom
 18:(230,440),  # A5
 19:(125,505),  # A4 phenol C
 20:(137,560),  # O phenol
 21:(20,440),   # A3
 22:(20,310),   # A2
 23:(125,250),  # A1
 24:(230,310),  # A6
 25:(330,255),  # B1 carbonyl C
 26:(330,135),  # O carbonyl top
}
s = 0.0113  # Angstrom per pixel
coords = {}
for i,(px,py) in pix.items():
    coords[i] = np.array([px*s, -py*s, 0.0])  # y flipped so +y up; viewer at +z

# Now set out-of-plane positions for stereocenter substituents
def place_sub(C, n1, n2, sign):
    u1 = coords[n1]-coords[C]; u1/=np.linalg.norm(u1)
    u2 = coords[n2]-coords[C]; u2/=np.linalg.norm(u2)
    w = u1+u2; w/=np.linalg.norm(w)
    d = -w*0.567 + np.array([0,0,0.824])*sign
    return d

# V2(5): neighbors in ring: 4(V1),7(V3); O(6) down; H implicit
d = place_sub(5,4,7,-1); coords[6] = coords[5] + d*1.43
# V3(7): neighbors 5,9; O(8) up
d = place_sub(7,5,9,+1); coords[8] = coords[7] + d*1.43
# V4(9): neighbors 7,12; Me(10) up, O(11) down
d = place_sub(9,7,12,+1); coords[10] = coords[9] + d*1.54
d = place_sub(9,7,12,-1); coords[11] = coords[9] + d*1.43
# V5(12): neighbors 9,3; O(13) down
d = place_sub(12,9,3,-1); coords[13] = coords[12] + d*1.43

# build conformer in atom index order
n = m.GetNumAtoms()
conf = Chem.Conformer(n)
for i in range(n):
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i, coords[i].tolist())
m.RemoveAllConformers()
m.AddConformer(conf)

Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m, confId=0, replaceExistingTags=True)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
    if a.GetChiralTag() != Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED:
        print("Stereo:", a.GetIdx(), a.GetSymbol(), a.GetChiralTag())
iso = Chem.MolToSmiles(m, isomericSmiles=True)
print("Isomeric SMILES:", iso)

import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

iso = "C[C@]1(O)[C@H](O)c2c(c3c(=O)c4cccc(O)c4c(=O)c=3c2=[N+]=[N-])[C@H](O)[C@H]1O"
m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(iso)
m = Chem.AddHs(m)
params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
params.randomSeed = 42
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, params)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=2000)

# pixel xy for sp2 reference atoms (heavy atoms on the conjugated plane)
ref = {2:(555,467),3:(657,368),4:(552,275),14:(437,308),15:(437,432),16:(330,490),
       18:(230,440),19:(125,505),21:(20,440),22:(20,310),23:(125,250),24:(230,310),
       25:(330,255),5:(597,165),7:(712,158),9:(778,245),12:(742,358)}
conf = m.GetConformer()
P3d = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ref])
P2d = np.array([[x,-y] for x,y in ref.values()])  # y flipped
# Kabsch: fit 3d -> 2d plane (only x,y of 3d aligned to pixel xy, keep z)
A = P3d - P3d.mean(0); B = P2d - P2d.mean(0)
# scale
sc = np.sqrt((B**2).sum()/ (A[:,:2]**2).sum())
# rotation in 2D
H = A[:,:2].T @ B[:,:2]
U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(H)
R2 = Vt.T @ U.T
if np.linalg.det(R2)<0: Vt[-1]*=-1; R2 = Vt.T@U.T
# transform all atoms
def transformed(idx):
    p = np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(idx))
    xy = (p[:2]-P3d.mean(0)[:2]) @ R2.T * sc
    return np.array([xy[0],xy[1],p[2]])
for idx,label,exp in [(6,"V2-OH","down(-)"),(8,"V3-OH","up(+)"),(10,"V4-Me","up(+)"),
                      (11,"V4-OH","down(-)"),(13,"V5-OH","down(-)")]:
    t = transformed(idx)
    print(f"{label}: z={t[2]:+.2f}  expected {exp}")
# also check z of ring carbons 5,7,9,12
for idx in [5,7,9,12]:
    t = transformed(idx); print("ringC",idx,"z=",round(t[2],2))

from rdkit import Chem

# load optimized xyz into the molecule (heavy atom order must match original 27-atom order)
achiral = "[N-]=[N+]=C1C2=C(C(O)C(O)C(O)(C)C2O)C3=C1C(=O)c1c(O)cccc1C3=O"
m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(achiral)
mh = Chem.AddHs(m)

lines = open('optimized.xyz').read().splitlines()
n = int(lines[0]); print("atoms:", n)
coords = []
for ln in lines[2:2+n]:
    el,x,y,z = ln.split()
    coords.append((el,float(x),float(y),float(z)))
# heavy atom coords in order (filter H)
heavy = [c for c in coords if c[0]!='H']
print("heavy atoms:", len(heavy))
conf = Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,(el,x,y,z) in enumerate(heavy):
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i,(x,y,z))
m.AddConformer(conf)

def face_sign(coords,C,n1,n2,X):
    c=np.array(coords[C]);a=np.array(coords[n1]);b=np.array(coords[n2]);x=np.array(coords[X])
    return np.sign(np.dot(x-c,np.cross(a-c,b-c)))
cd = {i:np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(27)}
tests = [("V2-OH(down)",5,4,7,6,-1),("V3-OH(up)",7,5,9,8,1),("V4-Me(up)",9,7,12,10,1),
         ("V4-OH(down)",9,7,12,11,-1),("V5-OH(down)",12,9,3,13,-1)]

    sg = face_sign(cd,C,n1,n2,X)
    print(f"{name}: {sg:+.0f} expected {exp:+.0f} {'OK' if sg==exp else 'FAIL'}")
    if sg!=exp: ok=False
print("STEREO", "ALL OK" if ok else "PROBLEM")

# check diazo geometry: C-N-N angle (atoms 2,1,0)
import math
def ang(a,b,c):
    v1=np.array(a)-np.array(b); v2=np.array(c)-np.array(b)
    return math.degrees(math.acos(np.dot(v1,v2)/np.linalg.norm(v1)/np.linalg.norm(v2)))
print("C=N-N angle:", round(ang(cd[2],cd[1],cd[0]),1), "deg (should be ~180 for diazo)")
d = np.linalg.norm(cd[2]-cd[1]); print("C=N dist:", round(d,3))
d = np.linalg.norm(cd[1]-cd[0]); print("N=N dist:", round(d,3))
